PLANS WHEN FLYING THE WHOLE LENGTH OF THE NAT TRACK.

PRIOR TO ENTERING THE SHANWICK OCA MUST INITIATE A LOGON TO
EGGX 10 TO 25 MINS PRIOR TO OCA ENTRY.
